concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish genetic, species and ecological diversity with examples from India.

topics.title: How many species are there on earth and in India

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how the global number of species is estimated and how recorded species are distributed among taxa.
Explain why India is a mega diversity country and estimate its undiscovered species.
Explain the latitudinal gradient in species diversity and the hypotheses for tropical richness.
Interpret the species-area relationship log S = log C + Z log A and the meaning of Z.

topics.title: Importance of species diversity to the ecosystem

concepts.learning_objective: Relate species richness to the stability and productivity of a community using Tilman's findings.
Use Paul Ehrlich's rivet popper analogy to explain the effect of species loss on ecosystems.
Compare present extinction rates with past mass extinctions and state their consequences.
Identify the four major causes of biodiversity loss and apply them to examples.
Distinguish narrowly and broadly utilitarian reasons for conserving biodiversity.
State the ethical argument for conserving every species.
Explain in situ conservation through protected areas and sacred groves.
Define biodiversity hotspots and identify those covering India.
Describe ex situ conservation methods and when they are needed.
